title: 长桥总览
Longbridge overview
description: 按问题组织行情与账户查询，识别所需数据、选择工具并说明结论依据。
Organize market and account queries, choose relevant tools and explain the evidence behind conclusions.
unsupported_capabilities: 交易、自动化与其他尚未接入的长桥能力
Trading, automation and other unconnected Longbridge capabilities
workflow: 确认标的、市场、时间范围和问题所需证据。
Identify the security, market, period and evidence needed.
仅调用问题需要且已授权的查询工具；账户数据按需读取。
Use only relevant authorized queries; access account data only when needed.
说明来源、币种、数据时间，并区分事实、判断和数据缺口。
State sources, currency and data timestamps; separate facts, interpretation and missing evidence.
examples: 用长桥查一下 AAPL.US 的最新报价，说明数据时间和币种。
Use Longbridge to get the latest AAPL.US quote, including its timestamp and currency.

title: 行情数据
Market data
description: 查询报价、K 线、资金流和证券资料，为市场观察提供数据基础。
Retrieve quotes, candles, capital flows and security information for market analysis.
unsupported_capabilities: 盘口深度、逐笔成交、行情推送
Order book depth, tick trades and streaming quotes
外汇、IPO、ADR 溢价与市场情绪数据
FX, IPO, ADR premium and market sentiment data
workflow: 确认股票代码、交易市场、周期和复权方式。
Confirm the symbol, market, interval and adjustment mode.
按实际工具参数获取报价、K 线或资金流，避免重复请求。
Retrieve quotes, candles or flows using the actual tool schema; avoid duplicate requests.
保留原始时间、币种和数据来源，区分盘中快照与正式收盘数据。
Preserve timestamps, currency and sources; distinguish snapshots from official closing data.
examples: 用长桥查询腾讯最近 20 根日 K，并描述成交量变化。
Use Longbridge to get Tencent’s last 20 daily candles and describe changes in volume.

title: 技术分析
Technical analysis
description: 基于 K 线观察价格结构、成交量和可能的支撑阻力，明确分析条件。
Use candles to examine price structure, volume and possible support and resistance, with explicit assumptions.

title: 基础 K 线、量价与趋势观察
Basic candle, price-volume and trend analysis

unsupported_capabilities: 专用指标计算与回测引擎
Dedicated indicator calculation and backtesting engines
缠论、SMC、谐波、艾略特波浪等专用分析模块
Dedicated Chan, SMC, harmonic and Elliott wave modules
workflow: 先确认时间周期，再取得足够的 OHLCV 样本。
Confirm the interval and retrieve sufficient OHLCV samples.
根据实际 K 线描述趋势、量价变化和候选支撑阻力。
Describe trends, price-volume changes and candidate support and resistance using retrieved candles.
区分观察与预测；未计算的指标不得给出数值。
Separate observations from predictions; never invent uncomputed indicator values.
examples: 用长桥日 K 分析 AAPL.US 近期的量价走势，并说明样本范围。
Analyze AAPL.US price and volume using Longbridge daily candles and state the sample period.

title: 基本面
Fundamentals
description: 读取证券基本资料与报价，解释已返回的每股指标和数据局限。
Read security information and quotes, explaining returned per-share metrics and their limits.

title: 证券基本资料与已返回的每股指标
Security information and returned per-share metrics
结合当前报价观察基础估值
Basic valuation context using current quotes

unsupported_capabilities: 完整财务报表、业务分部与同业比较
Full financial statements, business segments and peer comparisons
DCF 估值、财务质量与高管分析
DCF valuation, financial quality and executive analysis
workflow: 确认证券及市场，获取资料和必要报价。
Identify the security and market, then retrieve information and relevant quotes.
仅解释实际返回的 EPS、BPS 等字段，保留单位与周期；缺失字段明确标记。
Explain only returned fields such as EPS or BPS with units and periods; identify missing fields.
说明资料不足以支持完整财务质量判断或 DCF 结论。
Explain why this data alone cannot support a full financial-quality or DCF conclusion.
examples: 用长桥查看 AAPL.US 的证券资料，解释返回的每股指标及局限。
Use Longbridge to inspect AAPL.US security information and explain the returned per-share metrics and limitations.

title: 账户与持仓
Portfolio & account
description: 汇总已授权账户的现金余额与股票持仓，说明币种和查询时间。
Summarize authorized cash balances and stock positions with currencies and retrieval times.
unsupported_capabilities: 基金持仓、资金流水、账单和订单查询
Fund positions, cash flows, statements and order queries
VaR 风险计算、再平衡、定投和交易操作
VaR calculations, rebalancing, recurring investments and trading
workflow: 仅在用户问题需要时读取账户信息，确认范围和币种。
Read account information only when the request needs it; establish scope and currencies.
查询余额或股票持仓，按返回币种分组，不擅自换汇汇总。
Retrieve balances or stock positions and group by returned currency without assuming exchange rates.
区分现金与资产估值，说明缺少的价格、汇率和估值时间。
Distinguish cash from asset valuation and identify missing prices, FX rates and valuation timestamps.
examples: 用长桥汇总我的股票持仓和现金余额，按币种分别展示。
Use Longbridge to summarize my stock positions and cash balances separately by currency.

title: 新闻与公告
News & filings
description: 整理市场新闻、公司公告、监管披露与社区内容。
Organize market news, company announcements, regulatory disclosures and community content.
unsupported_capabilities: 新闻、公告、SEC 披露与社区内容查询尚未接入
News, announcements, SEC filings and community queries are not connected

title: 市场情报
Market intelligence
description: 结合市场榜单、异动、板块和资金数据形成市场观察。
Combine rankings, unusual moves, sectors and fund flows into market intelligence.
unsupported_capabilities: 市场筛选、排行、异动、ETF 资金与板块数据尚未接入
Screening, rankings, unusual moves, ETF flows and sector data are not connected

title: 期权与窝轮
Derivatives
description: 分析期权链、希腊值、隐含波动率及港股衍生品。
Analyze option chains, Greeks, implied volatility and Hong Kong derivatives.
unsupported_capabilities: 期权链、希腊值、隐含波动率和窝轮数据尚未接入
Option chains, Greeks, implied volatility and warrant data are not connected

title: 机构研究
Institutional research
description: 研究分析师观点、盈利预期、股东结构与机构行为。
Study analyst views, earnings estimates, shareholders and institutional activity.
unsupported_capabilities: 分析师评级、目标价、盈利预期、股东与做空数据尚未接入
Analyst ratings, targets, estimates, shareholders and short-interest data are not connected

title: 财报分析
Earnings analysis
description: 组织财报前瞻与业绩复盘，对照预期、指引和电话会信息。
Prepare earnings previews and reviews using estimates, guidance and call information.
unsupported_capabilities: 财报、业绩日历、市场预期、公司指引与电话会资料尚未接入
Financial reports, earnings calendars, estimates, guidance and calls are not connected

title: 量化策略
Quantitative strategies
description: 组织因子研究、配对交易、统计建模和策略回测。
Organize factor research, pairs trading, statistical modeling and strategy backtesting.
unsupported_capabilities: 策略计算、因子数据、统计模型和回测运行环境尚未接入
Strategy computation, factor data, statistical models and a backtesting runtime are not connected

title: 价值投资
Value investing
description: 通过财务核验、估值和安全边际框架开展价值研究。
Research value using financial reconciliation, valuation and margin-of-safety frameworks.
unsupported_capabilities: 价值分析所需的完整财务历史、现金流与估值计算尚未接入
Full financial history, cash flows and valuation calculations required for value analysis are not connected

title: 自选与提醒
Watchlist & alerts
description: 管理长桥自选分组、关注标的与价格提醒。
Manage Longbridge watchlist groups, followed securities and price alerts.
unsupported_capabilities: 长桥自选分组和价格提醒的读取、创建与修改尚未接入
Reading, creating and editing Longbridge watchlists and price alerts are not connected
